caseName: Park Square Automobile Station v. American Locomotive Co.
caseNameFull: Park Square Automobile Station, in Error v. American Locomotive Company
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of New York.
attorneys: Mr. Edward C. Stone for plaintiff in error., Mr. Robert G. Dodge, Mr. Moorfield Storey and Mr. Reginald H. Johnson for defendant in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of McLish v. Roff, 141 U. S. 661; Bender v. Pennsylvania Company, 148 U. S. 502; McDonnell v. Jordan, 169 U. S. 734; Heike v. United States, 217 U. S. 423.
